verdict_reason: mapToV4 is wired in but never exercised, an 'every payload' test skips v0.4.0, and a comment now miscounts the streams.

todos.issue: The PR wires pimsEventMapperV4 into setUp, but no test in the class calls mapToV4. The new public method's JSON output is untested against the backend fixture: no committed-payload check like mapToV2_shouldProduceTheCommittedV020PayloadForTheBackendFixture (line 230), no check that exchangedDocument has no issuer, and no schemaUri/schemaVersion wire check like mapToV1AndV2_shouldEmitMetadataSchemaUri_notSchemaUrl (line 330). NotificationSqsListenerTest compares mapToV4 output only with itself, so it cannot catch a wrong payload.
todos.fix: Must: a test proves mapToV4's serialised payload for the backend fixture: its data, no exchangedDocument.issuer, and metadata with schemaUri and no schemaUrl. One way: commit pims-v0.4.0-from-backend.json beside the v0.2.0 one and add mapToV4_shouldProduceTheCommittedV040PayloadForTheBackendFixture, and extend the schemaUri test to every version.

todos.issue: map_shouldIgnoreOwningOrganisationOnEveryPayload (line 111) compares only v1, v2 and v3 (lines 118-127). With v0.4.0 added, 'EveryPayload' over-claims: v4 is not checked. mapToV3_shouldOmitIssuerAndStillSend... (line 239) narrates a change with 'Still'.
todos.fix: Must: the 'every payload' test covers every version the listener sends, v0.4.0 included, and no title narrates history. One way: add the v4 pair to that test (or loop over the mapper functions), and rename line 239 to mapToV3_shouldSendNoIssuerAndSendDocumentTypeListUrlAndRegionOfOriginCode.

todos.issue: Line 332 says 'PimsEventMetadata is shared by both streams'; with v0.4.0 there are four. The file also uses Given/When/Then comments (lines 76, 90, 93, 199, 202, 255, 258, 261, 312, 318, 322, 331, 347, 351, 364, 382, 385). Lines 150-152, 193-196 and 296 are rationale, and lines 214, 218 and 283 restate their assertions in trailing comments.
todos.fix: Must: no comment in the file is untrue, there are no Given/When/Then comments, and rationale lives in docs/. One way: delete them, and use .as(...) where an assertion needs words.
